scope: Addendum to Reporting V2: QS working & reconciliation Excel. Presentation only - no engine, quantity, status, authority, owner fact, method, blocker or release change.
timing_disclosure: Drafted while the addendum code was being written (uncommitted); committed before the implementation commit.

formula_policy.rule: No formula creates or replaces an Urban engine quantity. Engine values are frozen register values (or declared sums of them) in locked cells.
allowed: 00 MAIN TOTALS BY TRADE: SUM over the frozen line totals of PROJECT BOQ LINES
00 TOTALS BY FLOOR: SUM over the frozen per-level line cells; TOTAL PROJECT row = SUM of the floors
00 coverage: COUNTIFS over the BOQ line status / class columns; share = DIV
08 subtotals / project totals of Urban values and of the manual checks
08 manual check arithmetic (COUNT x L x W x H, L x B x (D - t), COUNT x B x D x H, area x t)
08 difference, difference %, reconciliation status, check progress counts
not_a_formula: every PROJECT BOQ LINES line total (the canonical line quantity stays a frozen value)
formula_policy.validation: Each report total carries the deterministic value (exact decimal sum) it must equal; validate() fails otherwise. readback refuses any formula the model does not hold, any formula text that differs, an unprotected sheet, an unlocked engine cell or an unlocked non-input cell. LibreOffice Calc recalculates the workbook and every computed value must equal the Python evaluation; a what-if types manual values into a copy and checks every changed formula and status.

sections: CHECK SETTINGS / LEGEND (editable MATCH / CLOSE tolerances)
ITEM RECONCILIATION - BY FLOOR (filterable; floor blocks with thick borders; group subtotals; PROJECT totals)
adapter structural blocks: FOOTINGS / BEAMS / COLUMNS / SLABS (Alsenan)
sheet_08.columns: ITEM CODE, FLOOR, TRADE, ITEM GROUP, ROOM / ELEMENT, DESCRIPTION EN, DESCRIPTION AR, URBAN ENGINE QTY (locked), UNIT, URBAN STATUS, MANUAL / CHECK QTY (input), DIFFERENCE (= manual - Urban), DIFFERENCE % (= difference / Urban), RECONCILIATION STATUS, CHECK NOTES (input); plus ROW TYPE for filtering
sheet_08.colours: white / grey = engine (locked); light yellow = input; light blue = formula; green / amber / red = MATCH / CLOSE / REVIEW; grey = ENGINE BLOCKED / NOT CHECKED / NOT COMPARABLE
sheet_08.protection: every sheet protected WITHOUT a password (filters, sorting, formatting allowed); only the yellow input cells are unlocked
sheet_08.qortuba: generic 08 only (item, progress and architectural blocks): the RC1 registers carry no structural register

status_rules.ENGINE BLOCKED: Urban quantity is BLOCKED - never a mismatch, no difference, no %
status_rules.NOT COMPARABLE: Urban has no quantity on this basis (e.g. not measured / not on plan) or the manual value is not a number
status_rules.MATCH / CLOSE / REVIEW: |manual / Urban - 1| <= MATCH tol (0.5 %) / <= CLOSE tol (3 %) / beyond; Urban = 0: MATCH only if manual = 0
status_rules.defaults: tolerances are editable report parameters, not engine values

prefill_policy.footings: COUNT = tags found on the plan, L / W / H = schedule dimensions (register type summary). Shows F at REVIEW (+25 %): 5 tags vs 4 computed - the F / F10 SOURCE_CONFLICT outline Urban excludes.
prefill_policy.beams_columns_slabs: Only source facts are pre-filled (B, D, slab t, column count found). The measured quantities (clear length, clear height, net slab area) are left blank for the QS's own take-off; the Urban value sits next to them, locked.
prefill_policy.consistency_proof: Typing the Urban length / height / area into the check inputs gives MATCH on every computed beam, column and slab row (test).

disagreements_or_extensions: NOT CHECKED is a sixth reconciliation state: a row nobody has checked cannot honestly be MATCH or REVIEW.
PROJECT BOQ LINES line totals stay frozen values, not SUM formulas: the line total is the canonical QTO line; formulas only add frozen lines into trade / floor totals.
Marble and hidden profile have no Alsenan register: shown as NOT MEASURED (NOT COMPARABLE), not ENGINE BLOCKED and not 0.

The Excel file has no cached formula values (openpyxl); Excel / LibreOffice compute them on open (fullCalcOnLoad). The PDF prints the Python-evaluated values (= the LibreOffice-computed values, checked).
owner_actions: NONE (tolerances 0.5 % / 3 % are editable in the sheet)
